name: assign_sla_tier
description: assign_sla_tier: Assign an SLA tier to an incident ticket, setting response and resolution time targets. The tier must match the ticket's urgency: high urgency maps to tier_1 (1hr response, 4hr resolution), medium to tier_2 (4hr response, 8hr resolution), low to tier_3 (8hr response, 24hr resolution). Returns the expected response time.

sla_tier.description: SLA tier corresponding to the ticket's urgency. tier_1 = high urgency; tier_2 = medium; tier_3 = low.
